faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the AIIMS Delhi SRF recruitment?
faq.answer: The last date to submit your application via email for the Senior Research Fellow (SRF) (non-medical) position at AIIMS Delhi is 21st September 2026.

faq.question: Q2. What is the educational qualification required for the SRF post?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess an M.Sc degree in Life Sciences from a recognized university or institution, along with at least 2 years of relevant research experience.

faq.question: Q3. Is there any age limit for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Yes, the maximum age limit for candidates applying for the Senior Research Fellow (SRF) (non-medical) post is 32 years.

faq.question: Q4. What is the salary offered for the SRF position?
faq.answer: The salary for the Senior Research Fellow (SRF) (non-medical) position will be as per the norms set by the Department of Biotechnology (DBT).

faq.question: Q5. How can I apply for this job?
faq.answer: Interested candidates need to email their resume and photocopies of necessary documents to the specified email address before the deadline.

faq.question: Q6. What is the selection process for the SRF role?
faq.answer: The selection process involves shortlisting of eligible candidates followed by an interview.

faq.question: Q7. Is this a permanent government job?
faq.answer: This is a project-based recruitment, meaning the position is tied to a specific research project and may not be a permanent government position.

faq.question: Q8. What is the total number of vacancies available?
faq.answer: There is one vacancy for the Senior Research Fellow (SRF) (non-medical) post.

faq.question: Q9. Where is AIIMS Delhi located?
faq.answer: AIIMS Delhi is located in New Delhi, with the pincode 110029.

faq.question: Q10. Are there any application fees?
faq.answer: No application fee has been mentioned in the official notification for this recruitment.
